title: Gallery export requires the runner's template mode (unmanaged install + iterate) to pass, with the sample data in the template run (split from #35132)
body:
sweep#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbYJqoPAoSpWTMpH1yq

Source: maintainer — Warren, 2026-11-19 00:32Z in the objectstack priorities discussion thread: 「可以拆的都同意。」 (the split list's item 4: split #35132; the template-mode gate becomes its own card behind #35157, the rest of #35132 queues now). Rule: #35259 item 8.

Filing gate: ③ split from a maintainer-directed card (#35132; its filing words: 「客户可以从应用市场中下载安装试用」). Reader: the `domain:devx` seat, from `pm:queue` once #35157 closes. Dedupe: this is #35132's Ask items 2–3, moved; no other card.

Grade: p2 · area:devpath · Task · inherits #35132's grade

Blocked-by: #35157

## Ask (moved unchanged from #35132)

1. **Export requires the unmanaged install to pass.** `gallery-refresh` also runs `template` mode on each card's passing scratch build, and a card exports only when both modes pass. A refused install, or a failed template half, keeps the card out, with the reason in the PR body under `Refused`. The scorecard gains the `template` column, and `scorecard.md` shows it.
2. **The sample data in the template run.** The template half installs with the seed copy on and asks its questions over the copied rows, not over rows the runner seeds itself. This proves that what a trial user gets can answer the gallery's questions.
3. Tests: a template-half refusal keeps a card out; the sample-data questions run over the copied rows.

## Why it waits

Until #35157 lands, an AI-built app cannot be a template, so the template half refuses every card and the gate would block all exports. #35132 (manifest fields, listing facet, title, sample data, the check) ships first and needs no template run. #35134 (publishing) waits on this card.
